With initiatives like Nexters, Oktobafest, Tusker Fest, Olympics partnerships, Rugby partnerships, Football, and elephant conservation, the brand is making remarkable strides towards winning with a new generation of consumers. data.item: Balozi Lager is a rich, natural tasting beer made from pure water originating from the heart of the Aberdare and the finest malted barley with no added sugar. Balozi lager is all about a great drinking experience and perfect for connection moments, socializing, networking and relaxing with friends after a days work over a cold bottle of Balozi Lager. Boasting an amazing liquid that’s great tasting, with low abv and no added sugar, Balozi has gradually grown to be one of Kenya’s finest lagers - ultimately raking in the Monde Selection Award in both 2022 (Silver) and 2023 (Gold). Positioned as the “beer ya wananchi”, the brand name, Balozi, translates to Ambassador, and the brand has provided a platform to encourage the masses to become ambassadors of all things chill by starting conversations around unity, love and what makes us truly Kenyan i.e. a True Balozi.

data.item: In the early 2000s, Kenya faced a significant challenge with illicit alcohol consumption, leading to tragic deaths and widespread health issues among the public. Responding to this crisis, Kenya Breweries Limited (KBL) collaborated with the government to find a solution. The result was the launch of Senator Keg beer in 2004, a groundbreaking initiative aimed at providing consumers with a high-quality alcoholic beverage at an affordable price, under regulated conditions. Senator Keg, crafted using sorghum as its main ingredient, quickly became a beacon of hope. Sorghum, known for its resilience in high temperatures and low rainfall, not only ensures a stable supply chain but also supports climate adaptation for local communities. By promoting sorghum farming, Senator Keg bolstered crop diversification and enhanced food security. This initiative has been particularly beneficial for 47,000 smallholder farmers, predominantly from poor and marginalised areas, who now collectively earn over Kshs 2 billion annually. Recognising the importance of affordability in combating illicit brews, the government granted excise tax remissions to Senator Keg, enabling broader market penetration. This support not only made the beverage accessible to a wider demographic but also contributed significantly to its popularity. Today, Senator Keg stands as a testament to success, holding the distinction of being Kenya’s largest beer by volume and value share. Globally, it ranks as the second-largest individual beer brand by volume within Diageo, trailing only Guinness. Its impact extends beyond consumption metrics; it is also celebrated as the fourth most beloved brand in Kenya, boasting an equity of 10.6. This year marks 20 years of Senator’s existence and the brand still exemplifies how visionary partnerships, sustainable agriculture, and community empowerment can converge to foster economic growth and social well-being. Its legacy is not merely as a beverage but as a catalyst for positive change, transforming lives and landscapes across Kenya.

data.item: Captain Morgan is a premium spirit brand made with the finest Caribbean rums. Captain Morgan Gold was launched in 2017, targeting 18-to 24-year-old consumers in Kenya, anchored on Captain Morgan Original Spiced, which was launched in 1982 for the global market. The brand exists to inspire everyone to add their own flavour of fun. In FY2023/24, Captain Morgan launched its first-ever pan-African campaign, “Spice On” in Kenya. The new platform sought to captivate adventure-seekers who yearn to authentically express themselves and unleash their own unique flavours. As an unapologetic, authentic, and accessible champion of fun, Captain Morgan invites consumers to unlock their full potential by bringing something original, distinctive, and enjoyable to the mix. The brand leveraged the launch to unveil a brand-new pack design which is refreshed to match our new brand identity. With this new chapter we are looking to give our consumers unique brand experiences while maintaining the integrity of the liquid. The new Captain Morgan pack design highlights the quality, flavour, and spice of the liquid, with a refreshed version of the iconic Captain symbol to maintain recognisability. To add flavour to the spice in the year the brand also onboarded “Mejja” a Kenyan genge artist as the lead brand influencer. He enjoys a massive following by Kenyan youths as he embodies the character of fun. The positive consumer feedback on the campaign, influencer and the new look pack have seen the brand accelerate its performance growing double digits compared to the previous year. The brand has also increased awareness, trial, and penetration month on month to solidify commercialisation of the brand. #SpiceOn

data.item: The choice of presidents, and pioneers, White Cap is the beer for the self-made. Born over 70 years ago, White Cap has always been admired for its unrivalled quality brought to life through its all- natural, no-added-sugar taste made from the finest hops from Naro Moru and the purest spring water from the slopes of the Mt Kenya. Our passion for progress aligns with our bigger vision to become the most-loved premium beer by leveraging the natural power of WhiteCap to profitably recruit the next generation of premium, unpretentious, self-made consumer. White cap’s commitment to being an all-natural, progressive brand extends beyond beer into involvement in environmental conservation and a passion for the next great adventure; as seen in its partnerships with Rhino Charge with an intentional focus on sponsorship of women-led teams and teams featuring persons living with disabilities, Motor-cross, and the World Safari Rally championships over the years.

Because we take time to brew this beautiful liquid, we also encourage our consumers to take time to savour and indulge in it. Tusker Malt is paving the way and shaping premium beer culture. This is why you will see us in in the spaces the finest of Kenya has to offer.

data.item: At 4% ABV Tusker Lite it provides all the refreshing and fresh taste one looks for but without the additional calories we are all trying to avoid. This great liquid is achieved by formulating a special recipe consisting of barley, cornstarch, and hops to deliver a great tasting, easy drinking experience that is perfect for a fun time with friends and loved ones. Tusker Lite is a light beer with a fun point of view about life. It is easy-going, friendly and progressive and is owning spaces that are buzzing in energy.

data.item: In a world where conformity is normalised and individuality shunned, those that enjoy life’s truest flavours start by living their authentic selves. Tusker Cider exists to embody freedom and everything that comes with it. It is the golden, crisp, great tasting and refreshing cider that ignites your yearning to be who you really are. In FY2023/24, the aim is to accelerate cider performance to credibly drive LPA-24 recruitment and be Kenya’s go-to accessible, refreshing alternative to a classic lager, RTD, wine and flavoured drink, we creatively engaged our consumers in the on-trade, off-trade, and in third spaces through Garden of Eden Executions, that were focused on driving trial through sampling and converting this to purchase.

data.item: Pilsner Lager was first brewed in the 1930s in Allsopps brewery, growing to become of the leading beer brands for EABL in Kenya, Uganda, and Tanzania. Pilsner boasts superior liquid clarity through cold filtering for a crisp refreshing taste that is inspired by the original Pilsner brewing process in Europe. Pilsner celebrates the success of Uganda’s urban youth culture. It’s a toast to their resilience and grit and an invitation to savour every moment on the journey to success. In FY2023/24, Pilsner cemented its place as the leading partner of Ugandan culture, through partnership with Buganda and Toro Ankole kingdoms. We continued to delight consumers by activating 14 cultural partnerships, leveraging the culture platform to connect with the consumers in the lively upbeat occasion.

data.item: Introducing “Tusker Ndimu,” A refreshing and lively lemon-flavoured beer that tantalises the taste buds with a burst of citrusy goodness. This unique brew embodies the perfect marriage of a crisp lager and the zingy flavour that is a central part of Kenyan culture. Brewed-to-perfection, this lemon-infused elixir is a testament to EABL’s commitment to quality, innovation, and the celebration of Kenyanness. After all, Ndimu is what your mahindi choma guy uses to flavour your mahindi. Ndimu is what you squeeze into hot, ginger water to make dawa. And Ndimu is what we squeezed into a Tusker, 100 Years later, to bring that Zingy and Zesty twist to your favourite Lager. Here’s to celebrating Kenya, Kenyans, and Kenyanness!

data.item: A pale ale crafted to perfection, with hops from afar and waters from our mountains. A taste like no other for a toast in the summer. Indulge in the epitome of craftsmanship with our pale ale. Each sip reaffirming our dedication to excellence. We begin with only the finest ingredients, but our brewing process is where the real magic happens. A symphony of heating, stirring, and blending, all orchestrated to perfection. Ensuring that only the highest quality elixir reaches your glass. A labour of love, crafted with precision and passion. A magical mix by our premiere brew masters. Where new friends and old come together to share stories and laughs. To celebrate in the warmth of Nairobi’s endless summers, day or night. A toast to good friends, good vibes, and good taste. Nairobi Summer honours this glorious city and its wonderful people!
